_comment: Creator watchlist for the hero draft's creator meta signal (scout/creators.py). `creators` are pulled from their public YouTube RSS feed by `python ld2l_scout.py --refresh-creators` (also run by the Team Scout auto-refresh pass); `handle` is resolved to a channel id on first run, or set `channel_id` yourself. `videos` are hand entries: add a video the feed missed, or set `heroes` ({"Hero": [positions]}) to override what was read from a video's description (matched by URL / video id). `pin: true` keeps a hand entry alive past max_age_days.

creators.name: BSJ
creators.note: 11k coach; 'Top 3 heroes in every role <patch>' series lands within days of each patch letter

creators.note: took over the GameLeap channel in 2026; 'Top 2 broken hero for every role' + 'broken hero' videos per patch letter
